content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for Assam University Research Assistant Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 02-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the organization conducting this recruitment?
faq.answer: Assam University is conducting this recruitment drive for the position of Research Assistant under a DST-sponsored project based in Silchar, Assam.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available under Assam University Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Research Assistant post in this recruitment notification.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for Assam University Research Assistant posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 2nd October 2026. Candidates must ensure applications reach the destination on time.

faq.question: Q4. What is the mode of application for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode is strictly via email. Interested and eligible candidates must send their applications to the designated email addresses provided by the university.

faq.question: Q5. What are the educational qualifications required for the Research Assistant post?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a BCA/B.Sc/B.E/B.Tech in IT/CS/Data Science/AI/ML or B.Sc in Mathematics/Statistics with knowledge of Python Programming, AI, ML, or App Development.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary offered for the Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Research Assistant position will receive a monthly salary of Rs 20,000 plus HRA as per the project norms.

faq.question: Q7. When is the interview scheduled for shortlisted candidates?
faq.answer: The interview for the shortlisted candidates is scheduled to be held on 5th October 2026, following the release of the shortlisted list on 3rd October 2026.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee required to apply for Assam University Jobs?
faq.answer: No application fee is mentioned in the official notification, making the application process free of charge for all eligible candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Where should candidates send their filled-in application forms?
faq.answer: Candidates should send their filled application form along with a complete updated CV to [email protected] or [email protected].

faq.question: Q10. What type of job is the Assam University Research Assistant position?
faq.answer: This is a temporary research position established under a specific project sponsored by the Department of Science and Technology (DST).
